pairs.description: Combining saw palmetto with finasteride yields additive 5-alpha-reductase inhibition, potentially magnifying anti-androgenic side effects.
pairs.mechanism: Dual inhibition of 5-alpha-reductase isoenzymes 1 and 2, suppressing dihydrotestosterone conversion.

pairs.description: Saw palmetto has been associated with isolated reports of increased INR values and intraoperative hemorrhage when combined with warfarin.
pairs.mechanism: Potential mild antiplatelet activity and modulation of hepatic metabolic enzymes altering clearance.

pairs.description: Theoretical interaction whereby antiandrogenic and estrogen receptor-modulating effects of saw palmetto could alter hormonal contraceptive therapy.
pairs.mechanism: Competitive binding to estrogen and androgen receptors by liposterolic constituents of Serenoa repens.
